items.title: Graduation Owl with Class of 2027
items.alt: Brown owl wearing mint glasses and a black mortarboard above a book and large Class of 2027 lettering.
items.description: Gold laurels frame the year beside a rolled diploma tied with a red ribbon.

items.title: Pencil Character with a 2027 Plaque
items.alt: Smiling yellow pencil character holding a navy plaque with large colorful 2027 numerals.
items.description: A raised eraser-shaped hand waves above one red sneaker, while the number plaque keeps its full gold border.

items.title: Illuminated Marquee 2027
items.alt: Red 2027 marquee numerals filled with warm round bulbs, standing above a curling gold ribbon.
items.description: Gold beveled borders trace the clear digits while the full ribbon sweeps beneath the row.

items.title: Dance into 2027 Disco Greeting
items.alt: Magenta Dance into 2027 lettering beneath a mirrored disco ball, with a pair of glittering pink heels beside the year.
items.description: Silver mirror tiles and small star glints contrast with the sweeping glossy script and full shoe straps.

items.title: 2027 Gold-Number Party Glasses
items.alt: Purple glitter party glasses with ordinary clear lenses and four separate gold 2027 numerals attached above the frame.
items.description: A purple bow and small gold stars decorate the bridge and rims, with both temple arms fully visible.

items.title: Ready for 2027 Party Badge
items.alt: Teal shield-shaped Ready for 2027 badge topped with an orange striped party hat and wrapped by a gold ribbon.
items.description: Cream beveled lettering fills the dark center beneath the hat's small curled topper.
